finding: Ignored artifact deliverables regenerated during evidence refresh are treated as advisory dirty files and are not automatically included in the taskflow close target bundle, even when the task declares the artifact path as a deliverable.
expectedBehavior: If an ignored artifact path is declared as a deliverable and was regenerated by a task-owned validator, close readiness should either include it in the delivery/close bundle or emit a first-class required command to force-add and commit it as a delivery amendment.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0245 final-verdict evidence refreshed `artifacts/generated/atm-plan3-final/verdict.json`; pre-close listed no blockers but targetDeliveryFiles was empty. A separate governed commit `4813c4464a517a10d4f2351b9ab58d369c086934` was needed to preserve the refreshed artifact before close.
followUp: Teach taskflow close/evidence-run to classify declared ignored artifacts as owned deliverables and produce an exact force-add/commit recipe.
